1.0.2: Security: upgraded @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to 1.32.2 (DNS rebinding, ReDoS and cross-client data leak advisories).
Security: pinned zod 4.6.6 as a direct dependency (the MCP SDK alone resolves zod 3.25.76, which has a memory exhaustion advisory).
2.0.0: Own Teamwork.com OAuth (service appmixer:mcpservers:teamwork_mcp), so the MCP server no longer requires the Teamwork connector to be installed.
Breaking: set the clientId and clientSecret for appmixer:mcpservers:teamwork_mcp in the Backoffice and reconnect Teamwork accounts in existing flows.
Call Tool fails when the tool reports an error (for example Teamwork's 403 when MCP is off in the site's AI settings) instead of sending the error text as the result.
Teamwork.com has to allow the MCP server: Settings → AI → MCP → Teamwork MCP server, and Read-write mode for tools that change data.
